issues.reason: (Cardinality g n) is a point value for that group, so two different counts on sk_group_1 at strength 1.0 assert one group has both sizes — at most one can be true, and neither is anchored to its month.
The subject of 'dropped' is 'the number of people downloading music', so nothing in the words puts the PEOPLE in the undergoer slot (Core patterns: point at the words that put the atom there).

Intervals licenses (Start e X)/(End e Y) for 'from X to Y', and the decline did run from April to June, so both atoms are true of the content; the unrecorded from-VALUE/to-VALUE is the coverage gap the reviewer already files in q2, not a falsehood in these atoms.

Names and casing requires the entity's kind in one ordinary type atom 'whether the kind word sits inside the name or beside it' (the Kestrel River / Brindle examples), and no type atom for the_npd_group was emitted.
